generator_cmd: sh tests/data/android_fixtures/gen_signing_certs.sh tests/data/android_fixtures  # keytool -genkeypair + zip -X + apksigner sign (v1+v2); puzzle data = b64(token xor sha256(keytool -exportcert DER)), codec xor, no key
oracle_cmd: FP=$(apksigner verify --min-sdk-version 28 --print-certs sig_key_sha256_xor.apk | grep -m1 'certificate SHA-256' | awk '{print $NF}'); unzip -p sig_key_sha256_xor.apk assets/huntress_puzzle.json | python3 -I -c 'import sys,json,base64;k=bytes.fromhex(sys.argv[1]);d=base64.b64decode(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]);print(bytes(c^k[i%32] for i,c in enumerate(d)).decode())' "$FP"
